description: Reecopedia searches the primary texts of EU textile sustainability law and returns the matching passages with their source file and page, so answers can be checked against the document instead of trusted. The corpus covers ESPR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1781), the Digital Product Passport, CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) and the JRC preparatory studies for textiles. Typical workflows: ask a compliance question and get cited passages; browse a result list and open a full document page; walk the outline of a standard and jump to the section you need; locate an exact wording such as an article number inside one document. It never browses the open web and never writes the answer itself. When the retrieved passages match poorly it says so, and when the only match is a EUR-Lex national-transposition register card it warns that the date on that card is a notification date and not an entry into force. No account and no personal data are required.

defaultPrompt: Which products does the Digital Product Passport cover under ESPR? Cite file and page.
Find the CBAM certificate surrender obligation for importers, then open the full source page.
Find the exact wording "data carrier" in cwa18291_2025_dpp_textile_cirpass.pdf and list the pages.
